title: Independent Viz: Heatmap of Enhanced Trust Adjacency
abstract: Generates heatmap from my enhanced adjacency CSV (eval 277), using Axiom helper if aligns, else fallback print for independent analysis.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys

ENHANCED_ADJ = "storage/nova/enhanced_trust_adjacency.csv"
OUT_DIR = "storage/nova"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
PNG_PATH = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "enhanced_trust_heatmap.png")

def main():
    try:
        sys.path.append("storage/shared/agency_lab/utilities")
        from plot_quickstart import heatmap_v25_adjacency
        res = heatmap_v25_adjacency(ENHANCED_ADJ, PNG_PATH, normalize_rows=False)
        print("VIZ_SAVED", PNG_PATH, "RES", res)
    except Exception as e:
        print("HELPER_ERROR", str(e))
        # Fallback: print CSV summary
        import pandas as pd
        df = pd.read_csv(ENHANCED_ADJ)
        print("CSV_SUMMARY", df.to_dict())
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    sys.exit(main())
